mapper.sql: id, code, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at

if.test: request != null and request.keyword != null and request.keyword != ''

where.if: AND ( code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_role WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.status, COALESCE(rp.permission_count, 0) AS permission_count, COALESCE(ur.user_count, 0) AS user_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT role_id, COUNT(*) AS permission_count FROM sys_role_permission GROUP BY role_id ) rp ON rp.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT role_id, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM sys_user_role GROUP BY role_id ) ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (code, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{role.code}, #{role.name}, #{role.description}, #{role.status}, #{role.createdAt}, #{role.updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET code = #{role.code}, name = #{role.name}, description = #{role.description}, status = #{role.status}, updated_at = #{role.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{role.id}
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.status, COALESCE(rp.permission_count, 0) AS permission_count, COALESCE(ur.user_count, 0) AS user_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT role_id, COUNT(*) AS permission_count FROM sys_role_permission GROUP BY role_id ) rp ON rp.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT role_id, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM sys_user_role GROUP BY role_id ) ur ON ur.role_id = r.id
ORDER BY r.id ASC LIMIT #{request.pageSize} OFFSET #{request.offset}
